compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner selling a productized engineering offer, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency. It also contains unsupported company, security, performance, and office claims that should not carry into a revised page.

llm_problems.title: Old Applied AI positioning
llm_problems.issue: The page replaces GoGloby’s approved staffing and recruiting positioning with an Applied AI Engineering offer and deprecated AI-native production messaging.
llm_problems.fix: Reposition the page around the approved company description and the two current recruiting and staffing services, removing the deprecated offer and messaging.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

llm_problems.title: Tracking claims exceed the source
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Legal and security
llm_problems.issue: The page promises per-feature cost and return, AI adoption, and agentic commit-rate measurement, while the sourced Intelligence Layer reports velocity, code quality, and AI token cost sprint by sprint.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unsupported measurements and describe only the sourced tracking capabilities if relevant to the revised page.

llm_problems.title: Unsupported security architecture claims
llm_problems.issue: VPC deployment, metrics never leaving the client environment, and “zero exposure” are not supported by the sources, which specify metadata-only telemetry and no source-code access.
llm_problems.fix: Remove these architecture and security claims or limit them to the sourced security and telemetry facts.

llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Legal and security
llm_problems.issue: The page adds professional liability to the $3M coverage, while the Fact Sheet specifies a $3M data and cyber-liability policy.
llm_problems.fix: Correct the stated coverage scope to match the Fact Sheet.
